goal: Harden and clarify the Alembic main repository within its own boundary: uniformly contracted owned surfaces (HTTP, resident tools, CLI, daemon jobs), honest write-strict/read-tolerant failure semantics, unambiguous vocabulary, and a closed test/gate floor with tests in the main check pipeline.
nonGoals: No @alembic/core import-path changes (CO1 owns the coordinated wave).
No shared-asset manifest/drift gate changes (RC5/RC7 output).
No resident MCP tool schema changes without explicit AO0 confirmation.
No cross-repo interface negotiation (a separate interface-alignment demand follows after CO + AO + AG + CKG).
No AlembicPlugin or Dashboard-source edits; no version bumps or releases without user direction.

demands.title: AO0 Fact Freeze And Decision Matrix
demands.purpose: Re-verify the 2026-06-12 audit, freeze counts, and confirm with the user every visible-behavior change before implementation.
requiredEvidence: Re-verified findings A1-D6 with frozen counts (route validation 17/31, catch census, escape-hatch count)
User-confirmed silent-to-loud list under the write-strict/read-tolerant posture
User-confirmed permission-fallback fail-closed change and status-code honesty change
Resident tool schema touch list (default none) confirmed
RC6 SD-2 absorption into AO4 confirmed or rerouted
HostIntentContext legacy-args path ruling: retire plan or owner+consumer+trigger
AO1 route-closure list and AO4 numeric targets fixed

demands.title: AO1 Owned Surface Convergence
demands.purpose: Uniformly contract the owned surfaces: full route validation, complete registry, problem-taxonomy boundaries with honest status codes, handler registry, statically auditable gateway.
requiredEvidence: All 31 HTTP routes behind zod validation with negative tests for the 14 previously raw routes
Route registry completeness proof: /api-spec and /health represented or their exclusion documented in provider-contracts itself
Problem-taxonomy adoption evidence: routes return problem objects with honest status codes; 200+success:false and silent AI-fallback patterns removed per AO0 list
Resident tool handler registry with single wiring point; gateway resolver closures replaced by statically auditable declarations
Contract document generation verified against the completed registry
Full repo floor green: typecheck, biome, boundary/drift lints, unit + integration tests

demands.title: AO2 Internal Responsibility And Semantics
demands.purpose: Resolve the repository vestige, publish the glossary, replace presence-switched behavior with explicit modes, and own every compatibility path.
requiredEvidence: lib/repository vestige resolved (pattern completed or AuditRepository folded) with db-isolation lint updated and green
Semantic glossary published (session/job/search/tool, MCP tool vs adapter) and reflected in types or doc comments
HostIntentContext explicit mode type replacing input-presence switching; legacy path per AO0 ruling
Mode-flag taxonomy documented; internal-only flags converted to typed modes
Deprecated-cause representation per AO0 ruling (internal reason field by default)
Full repo floor green

demands.title: AO3 Failure Semantics And Edge Hardening
demands.purpose: Apply the write-strict/read-tolerant posture: fail-closed permission fallback, truthful job state, serialized monitor, bounded locks, visible degradations.
requiredEvidence: Permission fallback fails closed with typed error and audit log entry; negative test proves no silent full-access path remains
Daemon job async failure transitions the job record; queued-but-dead state impossible; snapshot staleness marked
File-monitor handling serialized with idempotency token; duplicate evolution proposals prevented under rapid-change test
Daemon lock bounded retry with backoff; multi-claim race test
Knowledge batch submit entry/tracker consistency on the persistence path
AO0-listed silent swallows remediated with negative tests; realtime broadcast failures surface diagnostics
HTTP shutdown coordinates in-flight jobs and SSE; path-traversal refinement on file-touching routes; resident tool args validated
Full repo floor green

demands.title: AO4 Test And Gate Floor Closure
demands.purpose: Put tests into the main check pipeline, add the missing negative suites, execute SD-2 dashboard-artifact wiring, and surface the escape-hatch ratchet.
requiredEvidence: Main check pipeline includes unit and integration tests (or a justified equivalent blocking gate) with demonstrated failure
New negative suites: HTTP auth 401/403, job cancellation, wrong project scope, resident tool arg validation
SD-2 executed: build:dashboard wired into release staging with demonstrated stale-detection failure, unified source resolution, documented vendor-refresh flow, submodule kept
Escape-hatch count surfaced in check output with shrink-only ratchet
CLI and project-scope suites added; coverage thresholds held or raised with before/after report

demands.title: AO5 Final Acceptance And Archive
demands.purpose: Run the complete gate matrix, review census deltas against the AO0 matrix, accept and archive.
requiredEvidence: Full gate matrix green including the new blocking gates
Census deltas reviewed: route validation 31/31, catch-block classes, escape-hatch count, coverage
Controller acceptance from raw diffs and gate logs; ledger archive entry; Wakeflow verification pass
